# 🍴 APNA RESTAURANT POS

A simple and professional **Point of Sale (POS) system** for restaurants, built using **Streamlit**. This project allows customers (or staff) to easily **select menu items, generate invoices, apply discounts, and confirm payments** — all from a clean and interactive web interface.

[![Streamlit App](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://apna-resturant.streamlit.app)

---

## 📌 Features

* 🛒 Interactive menu with quantity selectors
* 🧾 Auto-generated invoice with date, time, and line items
* 🎁 Discount system (10% off on orders above Rs 1000)
* 📥 Downloadable invoice in `.txt` format
* 💳 Multiple payment options (Cash, Card, Digital Wallet)
* 💾 Order history saved locally in `orders.txt`
* 🚀 Lightweight & fast – perfect for kiosks or small restaurants

## 🚀 Getting Started

### 1. Clone the repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/apna-restaurant-pos.git
cd apna-restaurant-pos
```

### 2. Install dependencies

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### 3. Run the app

```bash
streamlit run app.py
```
